propositions: Hand-curated *_PATHS manifests in autodeploy.sh fall out of sync when deploy-relevant infra files are added but not listed, causing silent drift to running environments (recurred 4+ times: nginx edge, host-nginx materializers, mcp-entrypoint.sh, materialize-deploy-key.sh)

Derive expected deploy-relevant paths from Dockerfile/compose COPY/install/ENTRYPOINT directives and filename conventions (materialize-*.sh, *-entrypoint.sh, compose-up.sh globs) instead of maintaining a parallel hand-curated list

Parser must resolve container paths to repo-relative files only (strip /app/ prefix, resolve installed-absolute by basename, discard build-time artifacts), keeping the derived set to real in-repo sources

Coverage matching must mirror autodeploy's git-pathspec semantics: a derived path counts as covered when any manifest entry matches it exactly or is a directory prefix (trailing slash ignored), not exact string membership
Support intentional exceptions via a commented exclusion list with inline reasons, each naming a real repo file, to encode deliberate non-deploy-triggering paths
Integrate check into make lint target for portability across CI/pre-commit environments using stdlib-only Python script
